rows.text: Our climate-related disclosures are guided by the recommendations of the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) as well as CDP’s (formerly Carbon Disclosure Project) Climate Change programme.

rows.text: As a Group, we want to enable a low-carbon and circular economy, empower our people and communities, and embed responsible business practices throughout our organisation.

rows.text: Sembcorp aims to help advance the global energy transition.

rows.text: Sembcorp’s Scope 1 GHG emissions and GHG emissions intensity was 26 million tonnes of CO2 equivalent (tCO2e) and 0.54 tonnes of CO2 equivalent per megawatt hour (tCO2e/MWh), respectively.

rows.text: Sembcorp remains committed to meeting its 2022 GHG emissions intensity target of 0.42 tCO2e/MWh.

rows.text: Sembcorp is greening its portfolio and helping to drive the adoption of renewables by partnering industry leaders.
rows.source_sentence: Sembcorp is greening its portfolio and helping to drive the adoption of renewables by partnering industry leaders to lead the charge together.

rows.text: Sembcorp expanded its solar business in Singapore, securing an additional 63MWp of solar capacity in 2019.

rows.text: Sembcorp’s global biogenic emissions amounted to approximately 531 thousand tCO2e in 2019.
rows.source_sentence: Our global biogenic emissions amounted to approximately 531 thousand tCO2e in 2019, compared to approximately 446 thousand tCO2e the year before.

rows.text: Sembcorp’s Scope 2 GHG emissions amounted to over 303 thousand tonnes or 0.3 million tCO2e.
rows.source_sentence: Our Scope 2 emissions amounted to over 303 thousand tonnes or 0.3 million tCO2e.

rows.text: Sembcorp’s Scope 3 emissions amounted to 3.8 million tCO2e.

rows.text: In some of our power plants, we employ closed loop cooling water systems to further minimise the need for seawater.

rows.text: In August 2019, over one million people in the UK were left without electricity for up to 45 minutes, after a lightning strike caused two large generators that power the national grid to trip which led to a plunge in grid frequency.
rows.source_sentence: In August 2019, over one million people in the UK were left without electricity for up to 45 minutes, after a lightning strike caused two large generators that power the national grid to trip which led to a plunge in grid frequency.

rows.text: Within minutes of the blackout, Sembcorp Energy UK’s fleet of rapid response gas-fired power plants swung into action to make over 600MW of electricity available, which supported the restoration of power to the grid.
rows.source_sentence: Within minutes of the blackout, Sembcorp Energy UK’s fleet of rapid response gas-fired power plants swung into action to make over 600MW of electricity available, which supported the restoration of power to the grid.

rows.text: These are used by the national grid electricity system operator to dynamically manage the system in real-time.
rows.source_sentence: These are used by the national grid electricity system operator to dynamically manage the system in real-time.

rows.text: With the growth of renewables in the UK’s energy mix, flexible rapid response gas engines and battery energy storage systems will play increasingly important roles to help address the intermittency of renewables by bridging supply gaps and ensuring the reliability of power supply.
rows.source_sentence: With the growth of renewables in the UK’s energy mix, flexible rapid response gas engines and battery energy storage systems will play increasingly important roles to help address the intermittency of renewables by bridging supply gaps and ensuring the reliability of power supply.

rows.text: We aim to be an organisation with a proactive health and safety culture
rows.source_sentence: We aim to be an organisation with a proactive health and safety culture

rows.text: We are committed to working towards the goal of zero fatalities and injuries in our workplaces, with a workforce that puts safety first

rows.text: To incentivise positive behaviour and practices, health and safety key performance indicators are embedded into relevant employees’ scorecards
rows.source_sentence: To incentivise positive behaviour and practices, health and safety key performance indicators are embedded into relevant employees’ scorecards

rows.source_sentence: We aim for progressive improvement in our health and safety performance, which is benchmarked against global industry safety statistics such as the International Oil and Gas Producers Global Safety Performance Indicators

rows.text: The Group has a Health, Safety, Security and Environment (HSSE) management system comprising Group HSSE Policy, rules, standards, and procedures.
rows.source_sentence: A Group Health, Safety, Security and Environment (HSSE) management system comprising: –– Group HSSE Policy –– Group HSSE rules, standards and procedures

rows.text: The Group is making health and safety an integral part of its everyday business and culture.
rows.source_sentence: Making health and safety an integral part of our everyday business and culture

rows.text: The Group continued to implement training and tools to nurture a proactive health and safety culture, including the Behaviour-based Safety programme and the 360 Safety Check tool.
rows.source_sentence: We continued to implement training and tools to nurture a proactive health and safety culture, including the Behaviour-based Safety programme and the 360 Safety Check tool.

rows.text: The Group suffered two fatalities in 2019 and is working closely with stakeholders to improve health and safety practices and prevent injuries.
rows.source_sentence: We suffered two fatalities in 2019. We are deeply saddened by the loss and are working closely with our stakeholders across the Group to improve our health and safety practices, and prevent injuries

rows.text: The Group HSSE management system covers key processes for effective health and safety management, including Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment, Incident Investigation and Reporting, Occupational Health Management, and Consultation and Communication.

rows.text: The Group equips its people with relevant HSSE and technical capabilities to ensure the presence of competent safety practitioners and line managers across its operations.
rows.source_sentence: Equipping our people with the relevant HSSE and technical capabilities ensures the presence of competent safety practitioners and line managers across our operations.

rows.text: The Group conducts regular quality checks to comply with regulatory requirements and ensure the safety of its water products for customers and end users.
rows.source_sentence: We also conduct regular quality checks to comply with regulatory requirements and to ensure that the water we produce is safe for our customers and end users, including our potable water products.
